name: Ethan Riley
bio:
Ethan's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, fueled by countless hours spent watching his father restore classic cars. He pursued a degree in Automotive Technology, specializing in paint and bodywork, where he honed his technical skills and developed an eye for detail. After graduating, Ethan sought an opportunity to combine his love for racing with his expertise in paint application.

Ethan joined Team WRT with a mission to elevate the visual appeal and performance of their race cars. He's known for his meticulous approach, ensuring that every paint job is flawless and contributes to the car's aerodynamics. He constantly experiments with new paint technologies and application techniques, striving to find that extra edge in performance. His dedication to perfection, innovative thinking, and ability to remain calm under pressure make him an invaluable asset to the team.

Ethan brings a unique blend of technical prowess and artistic vision to the paint shop. He views each car as a canvas and each race as an opportunity to showcase his craft. His ultimate goal is to be recognized as a leading expert in motorsport paint technology, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in terms of aesthetics and performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Ethan is of average height with a lean build, his focused gaze reflecting his unwavering attention to detail.

quirks: Always listens to classical music while painting.
Uses a magnifying glass to inspect finished paint jobs.
Keeps a detailed notebook filled with paint formulas and application techniques.
